results.test: Registered WooCommerce shipping tax fixture resolves a positive ten-percent rate
Ordinary and mixed carts cannot qualify using ordinary totals
At and above threshold customer pays only shipping above one cap
Shipping at or below cap becomes zero without negative tax
Zero threshold has no minimum but still requires a campaign quantity
Coupon, quantity and removal recalculate eligibility
Multiple packages share a single cart cap and alternative rates do not multiply it
Changing another package invalidates the first package allocation cache
Repeated rate filtering is idempotent and disabling restores original rate
Unknown package context, unsupported tax and unrounded base fail closed
Zero cap and unknown-currency default never invent a shipping discount
A changed store currency and external price edit are ineligible
WooCommerce session-rate cache cannot retain a full cap after package split
A deleted configured method cannot subsidize an externally retained rate
